card_scope: Hematologic malignancy detection across lymphoid B-cell (DLBCL, CLL, multiple myeloma, B-ALL), lymphoid T-cell (thymoma, T-ALL), and myeloid (AML, MDS, MPN) arms. Three-arm card structure reflects distinct biology — lymphoid B-cell arm vs T-cell arm vs myeloid arm have different directional panels, different EpiDISH discrimination criteria, and different calibration cohorts.

clinical_claim.v0_1_claim: None at v0.1 — framework_calibrated_pending_per_patient_validation. TCGA tissue-level A-score signatures characterized in Issue 002. Per-patient pre-diagnostic blood validation candidate cohorts identified (EnviroGenomarkers, MCCS, Northern Sweden + EPIC); not yet run.
what_card_does_NOT_claim: Pre-diagnostic blood detection of CLL, DLBCL, AML, or other heme cancers
Discrimination between heme cancer and inflammaging/autoimmune at clinical-grade sensitivity
Subtype classification (AML cytogenetic class, DLBCL GCB vs ABC, CLL IGHV mutation status) from blood methylation
what_card_DOES_document: Three-arm structure (lymphoid B, lymphoid T, myeloid) with arm-specific directional panels and EpiDISH discrimination
Stage 2 Moss NULL on solid organs is the diagnostic feature for heme cancer (inverted interpretation vs other cards)
SUPPRESSED tier added to framework vocabulary — A_immune below age-decade healthy reference is a real signal (immunocompromised state)
EnviroGenomarkers (Georgiadis 2017, n=347 with 28 future-CLL cases 2.0-15.7 yr pre-dx) is the priority v0.2 validation cohort
MARLIN reference (Capper 2025, n=2,540 acute leukemia 450k/EPIC) is the myeloid arm calibration reference

ccl_027_four_questions.q1_test_1_pooled_passes_cleanly: EXPECTED YES per Issue 002 framework calibration; per-patient validation pending VAL-082 EnviroGenomarkers
ccl_027_four_questions.q2_directional_panel_needed: YES per arm (lymphoid_B, lymphoid_T, myeloid) — not for bidirectional cancellation but for arm discrimination and subtype classification
ccl_027_four_questions.q3_compartment_specific_scoring: Stage 3 EpiDISH RPC lineage breakdown is load-bearing for heme-epic — distinguishes myeloid (neutrophil shift) vs lymphoid B (B-cell shift) vs lymphoid T (T-cell shift) vs uniform (inflammaging, NOT cancer)
ccl_027_four_questions.q4_test_2_lymphoid_myeloid_split: BUILT INTO CARD STRUCTURE at v0.1 — heme-epic IS the test 2 pattern instantiated as a card. Three arms map directly to lineage discrimination.

stage_2_moss_interpretation.expected_pattern: NULL across all 18 Moss solid tissues
stage_2_moss_interpretation.rationale: The immune compartment IS the diseased tissue. No solid organ is shedding tumor cells. The NULL Stage 2 signature is the diagnostic feature for heme cancer (inverted interpretation vs other Cookbook cards).
stage_2_moss_interpretation.differential_with_solid_cancer: If Stage 2 returns elevated solid-organ shedding (breast_ductal, lung_epithelial, colon_epithelial, etc.), the Stage 1 immune signal is RESPONSE to that solid disease — route to the appropriate solid-organ card, NOT heme-epic.

stage_3_epidish_discriminator.reference_panel: Salas 2018 EpiDISH RPC (extended with Loyfer 2023 atlas where lymphoid sub-resolution is needed)

lineage_shift_to_arm_routing.uniform_elevation: NOT heme cancer — route to immune-atlas for differential (inflammaging, autoimmune, chronic infection)
lineage_shift_to_arm_routing.uniform_suppression: SUPPRESSED tier — immunocompromised state, route to clinical interpretation

SUPPRESSED.interpretation: Immunocompromised state. Discriminate via Stage 3 (uniform suppression vs targeted lineage suppression).
differentials: late-stage heme cancer with marrow infiltration

NORMAL.interpretation: No heme-epic call. Annual retest to track trajectory.

MARGINAL.interpretation: Likely inflammaging or transient immune activation. Annual serial sampling.
MARGINAL.differential: inflammaging vs early heme-epic positive (Stage 3 lineage-shift discriminates)

DETECTABLE.interpretation: Heme-epic fires with subtype call. CLL-level tier.

URGENT.interpretation: AML or thymoma level. Hematology consult within 2 weeks.

FLOOR_BREACH.interpretation: DLBCL level. Urgent hematology consult, bone marrow biopsy consideration.

tier_thresholds_v0_1.patient_facing_bins: SUPPRESSED / NORMAL (with MARGINAL flanks) / ELEVATED / FLOOR_BREACH
tier_thresholds_v0_1.note: Heme-epic introduces SUPPRESSED to the framework tier vocabulary. Other cards (cardio-epic, immune-atlas, ad-immune) inherit it.

specimen_pathways.applicability: PRIMARY (alternate to buffy coat) — 70% immune-derived, disease lives in that fraction
calibration anchor only, NOT a screening specimen
future L2/L3 platform — methyl + nucl + fuzz + WPS + frag
specimen_pathways.validation_state: v0.1 methyl-only; full 5-substrate pending platform expansion

mandatory_covariates: race/ancestry (Salas reference is European-ancestry-anchored; sub-population calibration v0.2+)
known immunocompromised state (HIV, transplant, chemotherapy <90d, steroid >prednisone equivalent 10mg/day)
known heme cancer history (alters interpretation of all tiers)
active infection (acute infection elevates A-immune transiently; defer scoring to 6 weeks post-resolution)
recent vaccination (transient A-immune elevation 2-4 weeks; defer scoring)
pregnancy (decline scoring during pregnancy and 12 weeks post-partum)
MBL history (relevant for CLL differential — monoclonal B-cell lymphocytosis is the precursor state)
CHIP history if known (relevant for AML differential — clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential is the precursor state)
lessons_learned_card_specific: heme-LL-001 — Stage 2 Moss NULL on solid organs is the diagnostic feature for heme-epic (inverted interpretation vs other cards)
heme-LL-002 — Card splits into lymphoid_B / lymphoid_T / myeloid arms because biology is distinct; unified scoring would underperform
heme-LL-003 — SUPPRESSED tier defined here; other cards inherit
heme-LL-004 — Four-bin patient-facing tier set (SUPPRESSED / NORMAL / ELEVATED / FLOOR_BREACH) with MARGINAL flanks is framework-wide as of heme-epic v0.1
heme-LL-005 — Inflammaging vs heme cancer differential lives in Stage 3 EpiDISH (uniform vs lineage-specific)
heme-LL-006 — EnviroGenomarkers is the long-window pre-dx CLL cohort the framework needed (n=347, 28 cases, 2.0-15.7 yr)
heme-LL-007 — MARLIN reference (Capper 2025, n=2,540) is the framework-equivalent reference for AML/B-ALL/T-ALL
heme-LL-008 — Per-disease ΔA spread (CLL +0.098 to DLBCL +0.203) reflects programmed B-cell methylation perturbation, not noise; Cancer Amplifier g for immune class is 5-10× not infinite

edear_consumer_report_framing.v1_launch_role: Highest signal-to-noise card in the catalog. Strongest published pre-diagnostic evidence (EnviroGenomarkers + MCCS, both >10-yr windows). Best fit to trajectory-tracking subscription value proposition.
edear_consumer_report_framing.patient_report_template_lymphoid_B_patte: Your immune A-score is elevated above the healthy reference for adults your age. Your tissue-of-origin breakdown does not show solid-organ shedding above expected ranges. Your immune lineage breakdown shows elevated B-cell fraction. Patterns like this have been documented in research cohorts studying CLL, lymphoma, and other lymphoid disorders, including pre-diagnostic samples taken years before formal diagnosis. This is not a diagnosis. Talk to your hematologist about whether further evaluation is appropriate.
edear_consumer_report_framing.patient_report_template_myeloid_pattern: Your immune A-score is elevated above the healthy reference for adults your age. Your tissue-of-origin breakdown does not show solid-organ shedding above expected ranges. Your immune lineage breakdown shows elevated neutrophil fraction with shifted lineage proportions. Patterns like this have been documented in research cohorts studying AML, MDS, and other myeloid disorders. This is not a diagnosis. Talk to your hematologist about whether further evaluation is appropriate.
edear_consumer_report_framing.patient_report_template_T_cell_pattern: Your immune A-score is elevated above the healthy reference for adults your age. Your tissue-of-origin breakdown does not show solid-organ shedding above expected ranges. Your immune lineage breakdown shows elevated T-cell fraction. Patterns like this have been documented in research studying thymoma and T-cell disorders. This is not a diagnosis. Talk to your hematologist; chest imaging may be appropriate.
edear_consumer_report_framing.patient_report_template_SUPPRESSED: Your immune A-score is below the healthy reference for adults your age. This pattern has been documented in research cohorts studying immunocompromised states including post-chemotherapy recovery, post-transplant immunosuppression, HIV, and primary immunodeficiencies. This is not a diagnosis. Talk to your doctor about your overall immune health and any relevant medical history.

myeloid_arm.cohort: GSE62298 Glass 2017 AML 450K (n=68) vs GSE51057 EPIC-Italy buffy coat healthy (n=115 QC)
myeloid_arm.note: Single-cohort. Cross-cohort replication (VAL-084 MARLIN myeloid subset) is v0.2 priority per CCL-029.

lymphoid_B_arm.note: EnviroGenomarkers Georgiadis 2017 (n=347, 28 cases, 10+ yr pre-dx) is the priority cohort but is biobank-gated; requires formal data-access application via EPIC-Italy + NSHDS. Kulis 2012 EGAS00001000272 and Dietrich 2018 EGAS00001000174 also gated. No publicly-accessible 450K CLL methylation cohort with healthy comparator currently identified.

lymphoid_T_arm.note: TCGA-THYM (n=120) is calibration anchor at tissue level; per-patient blood validation pending.
